facts: It costs approximately $10,000 to train a federally certified search and rescue dog.
U.S. Customs dogs "Rocky" and "Barco" were so good at patrolling the border that Mexican drug lords put a $300,000 bounty on their heads.
Dalmatian puppies are born completely white.
A dog's nose print is unique, just like a human's fingerprint.
Dogs can be trained to detect low blood sugar levels in diabetics and alert their owner.
